description: Indoor party band, trumpet: slight, wiry musician of about thirty, tall black flat-top haircut.
traits: slight, wiry musician of about thirty, tall black flat-top haircut

closed cream shirt with a small midnight-violet bow tie

drawing.fits: the top of their flat-top, both shoes, both hands and the whole trumpet
drawing.look: small, slight, wiry adult build, narrow shoulders, slim angular face, tall square black flat-top haircut with shaved sides, light olive skin, long-sleeved cream dinner jacket buttoned closed with glossy midnight-violet satin shawl lapels, a small midnight-violet bow tie at a closed cream shirt collar, slim dark charcoal trousers and polished two-tone cream and dark shoes, and thick dark ink outline, playing a bright polished brass trumpet with a wide flared bell
drawing.extra: They are a grown adult of about thirty. The trumpet is at their lips, tilted up and out toward the right side of the picture, its wide round brass bell well clear of their head and easy to see against the background.

front.description: standing facing the viewer with feet apart and head turned a little toward the right side of the picture, both hands raised to the trumpet at their lips, elbows lifted away from the body
